summary: Dashboard hero redesign tested end-to-end for owner + manager. Backend /api/reports/dashboard returns inactive_customers_30d as int alongside existing keys. All new hero/Mira/actions data-testids render with correct hrefs; regression widgets (rating, pending-reviews, revenue-trend, staff-performance, top-services) still render below. Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow; hero stacks and script text hidden on lg breakpoint (hidden lg:block).

integration_issues.issue: Headless test env falls back to selection toast (clipboard blocked). In real browsers navigator.clipboard should succeed; not a bug — noted for context.

critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (unrelated to hero) React hydration warning: components/MiraDayOffer.jsx <select><option> contains a nested <span> injected via dynamic instrumentation — likely from build tool. If it recurs in production build, sanitize/simplify option content.
Dashboard.jsx is 700+ lines and hosts many child widgets — consider splitting RemindersWidget/StaffPerformance/RevenueTrendCard/TopServicesCard into their own files to improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified hero (dashboard-hero, dashboard-welcome-heading='Salon Admin ✦', hero-today-collection '4 appointments today · Collection ₹0 from 0 bills', hero-quote, booking-link-url ends with /book/miracurl-marathahalli, open-booking-link-btn target=_blank), 4 KPI cards render (kpi-revenue-today/bookings-today/revenue-month/customers), Mira row (mira-yes-btn→/customers?filter=inactive, mira-act-reminders→/appointments, mira-act-offers→/offers-studio, mira-act-assistant→/assistant, low-stock-view-btn→/inventory, mira-suggests-play→/entertainment), Actions row (qa-new-booking→/appointments, qa-create-bill→/pos, membership-promo-btn→/plans?tab=memberships). Backend GET /api/reports/dashboard returns inactive_customers_30d (int), today_revenue, today_bookings, low_stock_items. Manager login shows hero with 'Salon Manager' name and all KPIs; month revenue not masked because month_revenue_hidden_for_staff flag is false in current tenant state. Owner PIN dialog for month-revenue-lock-btn returned 403 in automation (no PIN prompt appeared); confirmed no state change (initial masked=0, remained 0 after cancelled toggle). Regression widgets present.
